_description: Primary Mathematics Curriculum (2023) — strand and stage structure. Progression Continua PC1–PC12.

strand_units.name: Patterns, rules and relationships
strand_units.description: Exploring, extending, and creating patterns and sequences; identifying rules that describe pattern structure; using rules to make predictions

strand_units.name: Expressions and equations
strand_units.description: Understanding and using mathematical expressions, equations, and variables

strand_units.name: Data
strand_units.description: Collecting, representing, interpreting, and analysing data

strand_units.name: Time, Money
strand_units.description: Understanding, measuring, and calculating time and money

strand_units.name: Length, area, weight, capacity
strand_units.description: Understanding, measuring, and comparing length, area, weight, and capacity

strand_units.name: Uses of number
strand_units.description: Understanding how numbers are used in everyday life and across the curriculum

strand_units.name: Numeration and counting
strand_units.description: Developing counting skills, number sense, and understanding of number systems

strand_units.name: Place value and base ten
strand_units.description: Understanding place value, the base-ten system, and number structure

strand_units.name: Sets and operations
strand_units.description: Understanding and using addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and their relationships

strand_units.name: Fractions
strand_units.description: Understanding fractions, decimals, percentages, and their relationships

strand_units.name: Spatial awareness, Shape, Transformation
strand_units.description: Understanding spatial relationships, properties of shapes, symmetry, and transformations (turns, angles)

PC9.S1: develop a sense of ten as the foundation for place value and counting; count, compare, and order numbers to 10
PC9.S2: count, compare, and order numbers to 100; understand place value to 99
PC9.S3: count, compare, and order numbers to 1,000; understand place value to 999
PC9.S4: count, compare, and order numbers to at least 10,000; understand place value to 9,999

PC11.S1: develop an understanding of addition and subtraction as combining and partitioning sets
PC11.S2: develop and use addition and subtraction facts to 20; add and subtract two-digit numbers
PC11.S3: develop and use multiplication and division facts; multiply and divide within 100
PC11.S4: use the four operations fluently with whole numbers and decimals

PC12.S1: recognise and create halves of sets and shapes
PC12.S2: identify halves, quarters, and eighths; compare and order fractions with like denominators
PC12.S3: understand fractions as numbers; find equivalent fractions; add and subtract fractions with like denominators
PC12.S4: compare, order, add, and subtract fractions with unlike denominators; understand and use decimals and percentages
